prompt: A sports stadium with athletes and spectators. A soccer player is kicking a ball toward the goal while the goalkeeper is diving to catch it. The goalkeeper is wearing gloves and pointing at the defensive line. On the sideline, a coach is holding a clipboard and gesturing to players. The coach appears more intense and focused than the referee. A referee is running across the field, blowing a whistle and pointing at a player. In the stands, spectators are waving four flags and a number of banners; the number of banners is two more than the number of flags. A sports commentator is speaking into a microphone from a broadcast booth high above the field. The broadcast booth is higher than the stands but lower than the stadium lights. A camera crew is filming the game from the sideline, with the cameraman focusing on the ball while his assistant holds cables. On the bench, there are three water bottles and a number of towels; the number of towels is one less than the number of water bottles.
